findings.description: A content-type parameter without '=' (e.g. 'text/html; charset') is now stored as value True instead of being skipped, so get_encoding_from_headers later calls .strip() on a bool and raises AttributeError.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a server sends Content-Type 'text/html; charset' with no value. The new code sets params['charset'] = True. get_encoding_from_headers then sees 'charset' in params and runs params['charset'].strip(...), which raises AttributeError. Before this change the bare parameter was ignored and the function returned ISO-8859-1. The impact is that a malformed header from a remote server crashes the response.encoding path instead of degrading gracefully.
